name: Encontrar numeros consecutivos adyacentes en una secuencia de enteros
untr_name: Finding Adjacent Consecutive Numbers in a Sequence of Integers
description:
Construya un programa que verifique si una secuencia de enteros, ingresada uno a la vez, contiene enteros adyacentes que sean consecutivos. El usuario ingresa -1 para indicar el fin de la entrada.
Tenga en cuenta que los enteros que se siguen en orden, sin saltos, de menor a mayor son numeros consecutivos. Por ejemplo, 12, 13, 14 y 15 son numeros consecutivos.
untr_description: Construct a program that checks whether a sequence of integers, entered one at a time, contains adjacent integers that are consecutive. The user enters -1 to indicate the end of the input.\nNote that integers which follow each other in order, without gaps, from smallest to largest are consecutive numbers. For example, 12, 13, 14 and 15 are consecutive numbers.
code:
#Paso 1: Leer el primer entero que el usuario ingresa
text = input("Ingrese un numero: ")
num = int(text)
#Paso 2: Leer el resto de los enteros que ingresa el usuario y verificar si hay numeros consecutivos adyacentes
while num != -1 :
    previous = num
    text = input("Ingrese un numero: ")
    num = int(text)
    if num != -1 and num - previous == 1 :
        print(previous, "y", num, "son consecutivos.")
untr_code:
#Step 1: Read the first integer that the user enters
text = input("Enter an integer: ")
num = int(text)
#Step 2: Read the rest of the integers that the user enters and check for adjacent consecutive numbers
while num != -1 :
    previous = num
    text = input("Enter an integer: ")
    num = int(text)
    if num != -1 and num - previous == 1 :
        print(previous, "and", num, "are consecutive.")

comments.content: Necesitamos repetir la recepcion de enteros del usuario mientras el usuario ingrese un entero distinto de -1. Por lo tanto, necesitamos usar una estructura de bucle. Como no sabemos de antemano cuantas veces se repetira el bucle, debemos usar un bucle while. La condicion en el bucle while prueba si el cuerpo del bucle debe repetirse, asi que debe comprobar si el entero ingresado es distinto de -1.
comments.untr_content: We need to repeat receiving the integers from the user as long as the user enters an integer that is different from -1. Therefore, we need to use a loop structure. Since we don't know ahead of time how many times the loop will be repeated, we need to use a while loop. The condition in the while loop tests whether the body of the loop should be repeated, so it should test whether the input integer is different from -1.

comments.content: El cuerpo del bucle while se repite mientras el usuario ingrese un entero distinto de -1. El bucle termina cuando la condicion del bucle evalua a False, es decir cuando el usuario ingresa -1.
comments.untr_content: The body of the while loop is repeated as long as the user enters an integer that is different from -1. The loop terminates when the loop condition evaluates to False, that is when the user enters -1.

comments.content: Necesitamos comprobar si el entero que ingreso el usuario es distinto de -1 porque -1 indica el fin de la entrada y debemos omitirlo. Tambien necesitamos comprobar si el entero que ingreso el usuario y su entero previo son numeros consecutivos. Para determinar si los dos enteros son consecutivos debemos probar si la diferencia entre los dos enteros es 1 (los numeros consecutivos deben diferir en 1).
comments.untr_content: We need to test if the integer that the user entered is different from -1 because -1 indicates the end of the input and we need to skip it. We also need to test whether the integer that the user entered and its previous integer are consecutive numbers. To determine if the two integers are consecutive we need to test whether the difference between the two integers is 1 (consecutive numbers must differ by 1).

comments.untr_content: If the integer that the user entered is different from -1 and differs by 1 from its previous integer, then the body of this if statement gets executed. Otherwise, the body of this if statement is skipped.
